title: 1-1 prep + follow-up - priya-shah
content:
Meeting date: 2026-02-20 (follow-up updated 2026-03-01)
Length: 30m
Direct report: Priya Shah (SWE II)
Manager: Liam Carter

Purpose: sync, remove blockers for v0.9.5 rollout, and agree 2 growth actions toward IC3 readiness.

Summary notes (manager prep + what happened)
- Quick check-in: Priya back to full capacity after a short PTO week. Energy level ok but mentioning a high focus load this sprint.
- Priorities: INF-3245 (quantization integration), PR #482 (batching optimizer), intern ramp for Anya.
- Blockers discovered: one deterministic regression in long-sequence test suite (repro steps on ticket), and a kernel-selection contention question from Neal blocking PR #482.
- Career: Priya agreed to own v0.9.6 postmortem and take the runbook lead for canary; will pair with Marcus for kernel tuning deep-dive.

Decisions / Commitments
- Priya will triage INF-3245 failing tests and add a clear repro + label flaky vs deterministic on JIRA (due 2026-02-24).
- Priya will post a patch addressing Neal's comment on PR #482 and link test results (due 2026-02-23).
- Liam to open SRE ticket if test failures look infra-related; SRE ticket opened 2026-02-21 (SRE-8743).
- Priya to draft v0.9.6 postmortem outline and initial canary runbook (initial outline due 2026-03-02).
- Weekly pair sessions scheduled for Priya + Anya (30m, recurring, first session 2026-02-28).
- Practice slot for eng-sync presentation booked week of 2026-03-09 (Liam to confirm exact slot).

Notes / context to file in artifacts
- CI logs: copied failing logs to JIRA INF-3245 comment (link above).
- Perf dashboard screenshots attached to Slack thread and saved in Confluence perf page.
- Short timeline of p95 spike created and attached to this doc (refer to perf timeline in Confluence).

Open questions / follow-ups for product/SRE/infra
- Product: which model variant to auto-fallback to if p95 remains regressed post-canary? (Assign to product-eng for a quick RFC).
- Infra: need confirmation on budget for long-sequence dedicated infra for extended tests.
- SRE: check whether the regression is caused by CI environment differences vs real hardware; follow up on SRE-8743.

Career / development plan (agreed)
- Stretch ownership: lead v0.9.6 postmortem + be primary contact for canary communications (gives cross-team exposure).
- Learning: 4-week kernel tuning deep-dive with Marcus Li; weekly pairing sessions + short talk at eng-wide sync in March.
- Mentorship: pair Priya with Marcus and Neal for technical review cycles; assign quarterly feedback checkpoints.

Action items (tracked)
- [Priya] Add repro steps and flaky/deterministic label to INF-3245 (due 2026-02-24)
- [Priya] Patch PR #482 addressing kernel selection comment; push CI results (due 2026-02-23)
- [Priya] Draft v0.9.6 postmortem outline & canary runbook (initial outline due 2026-03-02)
- [Priya + Anya] Weekly 30m pairing sessions (recurring; first 2026-02-28)
- [Liam] Opened SRE ticket SRE-8743 (2026-02-21) and looped SRE-oncall; monitor status
- [Liam] Book practice slot for eng-sync presentation (target week 2026-03-09)

Follow-up messages (template)
- Quick async to Priya after meeting: "Thanks for the sync — summary + actions: INF-3245 repro steps: @Priya (due 2026-02-24); PR #482 patch: @Priya (due 2026-02-23); SRE ticket opened: @Liam (SRE-8743); v0.9.6 postmortem outline: @Priya (due 2026-03-02). I'll ping Neal/Marcus if we need immediate help on kernel selection."

Prep for next 1:1 (topics to revisit)
- Status on INF-3245 repro + whether SRE ticket identified infra cause
- PR #482 merge status and whether Neal's concerns resolved
- Progress on kernel deep-dive and schedule for eng-sync talk
- Early signal about p95 after v0.9.5 canary (if canary happens before next 1:1)

Notes to self (manager)
- Praise specific wins in writing (prefix cache debug saved ~12% token cost)
- Encourage earlier cross-team comms for any dashboard-impacting changes
- If regression persists, escalate product fallback decision in next triage call
